items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This one’s on Riverside, produced by Orrin Keepnews.

ctx.x: This one’s on Riverside, produced by Orrin Keepnews. Any other recollections about this particular – I’m going to go through several . . .

Oh, I remember it all. The thing I remember about it most – I was the only one on there not known, and it was my date. I asked Max Roach, years later, why would you agree to record with this no-name guy? He said, “Oh, I heard about you.”
